g.text: Precise context from the code graph
Instead of reading the whole repository (~143k tokens), the agent asks the graph and gets a focused subgraph (~2.2k).
1 · The agent asks the graph instead of reading every file
2 · The graph locates the changed symbol
3 · Direct callers and callees are one hop away
6 · Indirect impact shows up two hops out
8 · Test targeting: run the tests that cover the change
9 · The focused subgraph returns as rich context: ~2.2k tokens, not ~143k
10 · The agent edits with the right neighbours in view
